{{Quote|I promised Master Dar'nala I'd tell you about the Sith Lord who ordered the attack on the ''Envoy''... I ''tried''...|Braden|<ref name="The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 2: New Galactic Order">''[[The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 2: New Galactic Order]]''</ref>}}
The '''''Envoy''''' was a [[Republic transport ship|transport]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] serving the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==History==
[[File:RepublicTransportAttacked-TORToP1.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The ''Envoy'' is attacked by a Sith warship]]
The same day as the [[Sacking of Coruscant]], the ''Envoy'' transported [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] delegates to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] to meet with representatives from the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] to discuss a treaty. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] delegates were led by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Paran Am-Ris]]. The Imperial delegates were led by [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth Baras|Baras]].

Not long after this mission and after [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Paran Am-Ris|Am-Ris]] had returned to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the ''Envoy'' was ambushed by a [[Harrower-class dreadnought|Sith warship]] under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Sivill]]. The ship was destroyed and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Dar'Nala]] was captured. Only [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Satele Shan]] and [[Sith Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[SP-99]] managed to escape in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]].

Later, Master Dar'Nala arranged for the release of [[Braden]], a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and fellow captive, so that he could report the attack to Master [[Zym]] on Coruscant. Braden made contact with Zym, but was forced to battle and [[Death/Legends|kill]] the Jedi Master when Zym attempted to arrest him for killing a Republic officer, [[Gin Lesl]], in retaliation for an earlier altercation.
